ideas.title: Bogged: the yacht sinks into the beach you sail it onto, and you dig it out with your own beak
ideas.critique: This is round 1's idea with what it lacked now spelled out: the field wakes wherever a body presses it, digging keeps the mass, and a push is capped by the shear under the pusher's feet. That answers the worry about a one-cart patch, and it is the first post in a long run where the player makes the trouble and gets out of it by hand, with friends. It still stands or falls on whether the digging and the pony shoving are bodies really working the sand or poses over a deforming mesh. The film has to show the yacht lurching free because the solver let it, not because a timer ran out.

ideas.title: Quicksand at the stream mouth: stamp and the ground turns to liquid
ideas.nearest: A snowball that grows as it rolls, a take that misses
ideas.critique: Ground that holds when you creep across it and turns soupy when you stamp, then sets around whatever sank, is new behaviour for the island, and daring a friend onto it is a real game between creatures. Its plainest version is a wet patch with a sink depth tied to impacts, a rig for one spot and a cliché of a cartoon scene. It only touches the cart through the route, and the planks already cover that.

ideas.title: Haul it out: the friends on a rope against the sand
ideas.critique: This is round 1's tug of war turned on the yacht, and it is one of the ways out that the Bogged idea already holds, so on its own it is a narrower slice of the same thing. The rule that where the friends stand decides it is good, but the most likely version is a line of leaning poses and a canned fall on the bottom, not feet really sliding in the field.
